specs.label: ArrowLeft forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: Document-level ArrowLeft is translated to special code 100 and forwarded to the backend as _button(100,-2). In local mode the engine drops key buttons, so the only observable is that forwarding does not throw; the real effect (movie 'backward') needs the remote backend (see keyboard.effect.left).

specs.label: ArrowRight forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: ArrowRight -> special 102 -> _button(102,-2). Local engine ignores key codes; assert clean forwarding. Real effect 'forward' is keyboard.effect.right.

specs.label: ArrowUp forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: ArrowUp -> special 101 -> _button(101,-2). When focus is in the command line ArrowUp is history-back instead; here focus is on the canvas so it goes to the global bridge. Local engine drops it; assert no error.

specs.label: ArrowDown forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: ArrowDown -> special 103 -> _button(103,-2). Global bridge path (canvas focused). Local engine drops it; assert no error.

specs.label: PageUp forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: PageUp -> special 104 -> _button(104,-2). Real effect 'scene previous'. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: PageDown forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: PageDown -> special 105 -> _button(105,-2). Real effect 'scene next'. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Home forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: Home -> special 106 -> _button(106,-2). Real effect 'zoom all'. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: End forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: End -> special 107 -> _button(107,-2). Real effect 'mtoggle' (play/pause movie). Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Insert forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: Insert -> special 108 -> _button(108,-2). Real effect 'rock'. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F1 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F1 -> special 1 -> _button(1,-2). F1 is NOT browser-reserved (only F5/F11/F12 are). Real effect 'scene F1 recall'. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F2 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F2 -> special 2 -> _button(2,-2). Scene F2 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F3 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F3 -> special 3 -> _button(3,-2). Scene F3 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F4 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F4 -> special 4 -> _button(4,-2). Scene F4 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F6 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F6 -> special 6 -> _button(6,-2). Scene F6 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F7 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F7 -> special 7 -> _button(7,-2). Scene F7 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F8 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F8 -> special 8 -> _button(8,-2). Scene F8 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F9 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F9 -> special 9 -> _button(9,-2). Scene F9 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: F10 forwarded as GLUT special (state -2)
specs.note: F10 -> special 10 -> _button(10,-2). Scene F10 recall. Local: assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Escape forwarded as ascii 27 (state -1)
specs.note: KEY_MAP maps Escape->27, forwarded via _button(27,-1) and preventDefault called. Local engine drops it; assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Tab forwarded (ascii 9) and preventDefault so focus does not move
specs.note: Tab->9 -> _button(9,-1); the bridge calls preventDefault so Tab reaches PyMOL completion instead of shifting focus. Local engine drops the button; the preventDefault-on-Tab behaviour is covered by KeyboardService.dom.test. Assert no error.

specs.label: Backspace forwarded as ascii 8 (state -1)
specs.note: KEY_MAP maps Backspace->8, forwarded via _button(8,-1). Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Enter forwarded as ascii 13 (state -1) when focus is not in a text field
specs.note: KEY_MAP maps Enter->13, forwarded via _button(13,-1). Only when focus is outside a text field (here: canvas). Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Delete forwarded as ascii 127 (state -1)
specs.note: KEY_MAP maps Delete->127, forwarded via _button(127,-1). Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Bare printable letter 'a' forwarded as ascii 97 (state -1)
specs.note: A bare letter with no modifier is forwarded as its codepoint (97) via _button(97,-1). Focus on canvas so it is not captured by the command line. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Space forwarded as ascii 32 (state -1)
specs.note: Space -> codepoint 32 -> _button(32,-1). Focus on canvas. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Bare digit '1' forwarded as ascii 49 (state -1)
specs.note: Bare digit -> codepoint 49 -> _button(49,-1). Focus on canvas. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Ctrl-A forwarded as control code 1, not the letter
specs.note: With Ctrl held the bridge sends k=upper-64 (Ctrl-A -> 1) with mod=2, and preventDefault suppresses the browser's select-all. Real effect 'select sele, all'. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding and that browser select-all did not fire (no console/net error).

specs.label: Ctrl-C forwarded as control code 3 (not browser-reserved by the global bridge)
specs.note: isBrowserReserved only spares Ctrl-R and Ctrl-Shift-I/J/C, so plain Ctrl-C IS translated (k=3, mod=2) and preventDefault fires globally. The focused command line handles copy differently (BROWSER_CHORDS), but the global bridge does not. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Ctrl-T forwarded as control code 20 (PyMOL bond;unpick)
specs.note: Ctrl-T is bound in PyMOL (bond;unpick) and IS forwarded (k=20, mod=2) despite Chrome's new-tab hijack, which is a documented browser risk not a defect. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Alt-A forwarded as raw uppercase code 65 (state -1, mod ALT)
specs.note: With Alt held the bridge sends k=uppercase-ascii (Alt-A -> 65) with mod=4. Real effect 'attach ala'. Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Alt-3 forwarded as raw uppercase code 51 (attach sulfone)
specs.note: Alt-3 -> raw code 51 with mod=4 (PyMOL binds ALT-3 to attach a sulfone). Local engine drops it; assert clean forwarding.

specs.label: Text-entry gate: Enter typed in the command line submits (not swallowed by the global bridge)
specs.note: When focus is inside the command line input, isTextEntry() returns true so the global keydown bridge does NOT intercept; the CommandLine owns Enter and submits the line, which the engine echoes as 'tenmol>...'. Affirmative proof the gate lets text fields keep their keys.

specs.label: Text-entry gate: printable keys typed in the command line reach the field
specs.note: Real keydowns for 'z','q','j' into the focused command line must land in the input (the bridge must not preventDefault them). Submitting echoes 'tenmol>zqj'. If the gate were broken, the letters would be intercepted/preventDefaulted and the echo would be empty -> feedbackMatches fails.

specs.label: Ctrl-Shift-I left to the browser (devtools), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for Ctrl-Shift-I so the bridge returns early without forwarding or preventDefault. No in-app effect; closest observable is absence of error/console noise (a positive 'nothing happened' cannot be asserted directly).

specs.label: Ctrl-Shift-J left to the browser (devtools console), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for Ctrl-Shift-J; bridge does not forward. No in-app effect; assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Ctrl-Shift-C left to the browser (inspect element), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for Ctrl-Shift-C; bridge does not forward. No in-app effect; assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Ctrl-R left to the browser (reload), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for Ctrl-R (cmd+r without alt) so the bridge never forwards it and never preventDefaults it. LIMITATION: driving this key can actually reload the audit tab; recorded for completeness. Only no-error checks are meaningful.

specs.label: F5 left to the browser (reload), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for F5 even though SPECIAL_MAP has F5->5; the reserved check runs first so F5 is never forwarded. LIMITATION: driving F5 can reload the audit tab; recorded for completeness with no-error checks only.

specs.label: F11 left to the browser (fullscreen), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for F11; the bridge does not forward. Headless fullscreen is a no-op; assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: F12 left to the browser (devtools), not forwarded
specs.note: isBrowserReserved returns true for F12; the bridge does not forward. No in-app effect; assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Bare Shift keydown is not forwarded
specs.note: keyEventToButtonArgs returns null for a lone modifier (Shift), so nothing is sent. Closest observable: no error/console noise when a bare modifier is pressed.

specs.label: Bare Control keydown is not forwarded
specs.note: Lone Control returns null from keyEventToButtonArgs -> not sent. Assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Bare Alt keydown is not forwarded
specs.note: Lone Alt returns null from keyEventToButtonArgs -> not sent. Assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Bare Meta keydown is not forwarded
specs.note: Lone Meta returns null from keyEventToButtonArgs -> not sent. Assert no error/console noise.

specs.label: Home triggers 'zoom all' (remote backend)
specs.note: On the real backend, forwarding special 106 invokes the PyMOL binding 'zoom animate=-1' (zoom all), which re-frames the camera. The local TS engine ignores key buttons, so this is BLOCKED here. Expected: the viewport re-renders.

specs.label: Insert triggers 'rock' animation (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 108 invokes 'rock' on the real backend, which oscillates the camera; over a settle window the viewport pixels change. BLOCKED locally (engine ignores key buttons).

specs.label: ArrowLeft triggers movie 'backward' (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 100 invokes '_ backward' (previous movie frame). BLOCKED locally. On a multi-state object the state indicator/frame changes.

specs.label: ArrowRight triggers movie 'forward' (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 102 invokes '_ forward' (next movie frame). BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: PageUp triggers 'scene previous' (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 104 invokes 'scene action=previous'. BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: PageDown triggers 'scene next' (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 105 invokes 'scene action=next'. BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: End triggers 'mtoggle' play/pause movie (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 107 invokes 'mtoggle'. BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: F1 recalls scene F1 (remote backend)
specs.note: Special 1 recalls the stored 'F1' scene on the real backend. BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: Ctrl-A runs 'select sele, all' (remote backend)
specs.note: Control code 1 with mod=2 invokes the PyMOL binding 'select sele, all, 1' (select all). BLOCKED locally. Expected: a selection named 'sele' appears and the console reports the count.

specs.label: Alt-A attaches an alanine to the picked atom (remote backend)
specs.note: Raw code 65 with mod=4 invokes editor.attach_amino_acid('pk1','ala'); it needs a picked atom (pk1). BLOCKED locally (no key handling, no backend picking).
